description: This file contains a set of tests (specifically for legacy FileHandle API usage) within the 'FileHandleLegacyAPIGuardTests' struct. It checks source files in the project for legacy non-throwing FileHandle read methods and throws an error if any such usage is found. Additionally, it includes utility functions for discovering Swift files in directories and stripping comments and strings from source code for analysis.

classes.name: FileHandleLegacyAPIGuardTests
classes.description: A test suite designed to scan source files in the project for legacy non-throwing FileHandle read usage. Implements methods for file discovery and source code analysis.

methods.name: sources avoid legacy non throwing file handle read AP is
methods.description: Main test method that locates Swift files in the source directory, reads their contents, sanitizes them by removing comments and string literals, and searches for usage of legacy FileHandle methods. Throws an error if such usage is detected.

methods.name: swiftFiles
methods.description: Helper method that recursively enumerates a directory between an URL, returning all Swift (.swift) files found.

methods.name: stripCommentsAndStrings
methods.description: Utility method that processes a source code string to remove comments and string literals, making it easier to analyze source code for specific patterns.
